---
title: "Analyzing US Births"
author: "Lizzie"
execute:
  echo: false
---

```{r}
#| cache: true
births_tibble <- readxl::read_excel("data/us_births_1994_2014.xlsx") |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    day_of_week = factor(
      day_of_week,
      levels = c("Sun", "Mon", "Tues", "Wed", "Thurs", "Fri", "Sat"),
      ordered = TRUE
    )
  )
```

```{r}
births_by_calendar_position <- births_tibble |>
  dplyr::group_by(month, date_of_month) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    average_births = mean(births),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

ggplot2::ggplot(
  births_by_calendar_position,
  ggplot2::aes(x = date_of_month, y = month, fill = average_births)
) +
  ggplot2::geom_tile(width = 1, height = 1) +
  ggplot2::scale_x_continuous(breaks = 1:31) +
  ggplot2::scale_y_reverse(breaks = 1:12, labels = month.name) +
  ggplot2::labs(x = "Day of month", y = NULL, fill = "Mean births")
```

```{r}
christmas_births <- births_tibble |>
  dplyr::filter(
    month == 12,
    date_of_month %in% c(20:25, 27:30)
  ) |>
  dplyr::group_by(year) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    christmas_births = births[date_of_month == 25],
    christmas_weekday = day_of_week[date_of_month == 25],
    surrounding_average = mean(births[date_of_month != 25]),
    pct_of_baseline =
      christmas_births / surrounding_average * 100,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

christmas_births
```

```{r}
ggplot2::ggplot(
  christmas_births,
  ggplot2::aes(x = year, y = pct_of_baseline)
) +
  ggplot2::geom_line() +
  ggplot2::geom_point(ggplot2::aes(color = christmas_weekday)) +
  ggplot2::labs(
    x = "Year",
    y = "December 25 births (% of baseline)",
    color = "Weekday"
  )
```

```{r}
births_model <- stats::lm(
  births ~ year + month + day_of_week,
  data = births_tibble
)

summary(births_model)$r.squared
```

```{r}
births_adjusted <- births_tibble |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    pct_resid = stats::residuals(births_model) / mean(births) * 100
  )

calendar_resid <- births_adjusted |>
  dplyr::filter(!(month == 2 & date_of_month == 29)) |>
  dplyr::group_by(month, date_of_month) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    mean_pct_resid = mean(pct_resid),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    calendar_date = as.Date(sprintf("2001-%02d-%02d", month, date_of_month))
  )

calendar_resid
```

```{r}
holiday_dips <- calendar_resid |>
  dplyr::filter(
    calendar_date %in% as.Date(c("2001-12-25", "2001-01-01", "2001-07-04"))
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    holiday = dplyr::case_when(
      calendar_date == as.Date("2001-12-25") ~ "Christmas",
      calendar_date == as.Date("2001-01-01") ~ "New Year's Day",
      calendar_date == as.Date("2001-07-04") ~ "Independence Day"
    ),
    label_date = dplyr::case_when(
      calendar_date == as.Date("2001-12-25") ~ as.Date("2001-12-15"),
      calendar_date == as.Date("2001-01-01") ~ as.Date("2001-01-25"),
      calendar_date == as.Date("2001-07-04") ~ as.Date("2001-07-09")
    )
  )

ggplot2::ggplot(
  calendar_resid,
  ggplot2::aes(x = calendar_date, y = mean_pct_resid)
) +
  ggplot2::geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "gray50") +
  ggplot2::geom_line() +
  ggplot2::geom_label(
    data = holiday_dips,
    ggplot2::aes(x = label_date, y = mean_pct_resid + 5, label = holiday),
    inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +
  ggplot2::labs(x = "Calendar date", y = "Mean residual (% of mean births)")
```
